requests.description: Associates a skill with the organization under the customer's AWS account. If a skill is private, the user implicitly accepts access to this skill during enablement.
requests.name: POST /#X-Amz-Target=AlexaForBusiness.ApproveSkill
requests.note: Replace {{ALEXA_FOR_BUSINESS_API_KEY}} with your API key | Replace path parameters (e.g. {{VOICE_ID}}) with actual values

requests.description: Associates a device with a given room. This applies all the settings from the room profile to the device, and all the skills in any skill groups added to that room. This operation requires the device to be online, or else a manual sync is required.
